documentation.content:
The daily credit-only roller (FC-078), wired for the covered-call service by FC-100, executed a roll, stranded a buy-to-close, or could not establish what an order did. This is the CC twin of the wheel's policy and watches ONLY covered-call-engine.

Conditions:
- call_roll_completed: both legs done. Informational; a two-leg live order pair - look the same day.
- call_roll_naked_exposure: BTC filled, every STO rung failed. Shares UNCOVERED (long-only, no naked short). Re-covered later via the entry path.
- call_roll_partial_naked_exposure: STO filled fewer contracts than the BTC closed; the difference is uncovered.
- call_roll_unknown_disposition / call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown: ACT ON THIS ONE. A cancel did not settle; an order may still be working. Check the Alpaca account (PA37XLNWDLB3) before the next 15:30 cycle.
- call_roll_execution_error: exception escaped execute_roll; may have left a filled BTC behind.
- call_roll_order_refetch_failed: order reads failing during a poll; if it precedes unknown-disposition it is the cause.
- roll_cycle_error: the /roll handler raised; the whole cycle died.
- roll_position_error: one position's evaluate/execute raised; that position got no roll.

Triage (every command names covered-call-engine - never the wheel's service or dataset):
1. gcloud logging read 'resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type=~"^(call_roll_|roll_cycle_|roll_position_)" OR jsonPayload.event=~"^roll_cycle_" OR textPayload:"call_roll_" OR textPayload:"roll_cycle_")' --limit=20 --freshness=1d
   The jsonPayload.event clause is LOAD-BEARING: roll_cycle_started/completed are logged via log_system_event with the name as the MESSAGE (no event_type field). Without it you see every call_roll_* row and zero cycle rows.
2. Completed roll: confirm both fills in covered_call.trades_from_activities after the next cc-activities-ingest (:07 hourly); no residual open order. New strike > old, >= Alpaca avg_entry_price, STO fill - BTC fill >= 0 (fees ~$0.10/contract).
3. Uncovered shares: confirm the next /scan -> /run re-covered. Held uncovered through earnings by the span gate is correct - record, do not override.
4. Unknown disposition: reconcile orders and positions by hand; do not re-trigger /roll until they match.
5. Cycle/position error: read the exception; decide whether to pause the job before 15:30 tomorrow.

Stop the CC roller without a deploy: gcloud run services update covered-call-engine --region=us-central1 --update-env-vars ROLLER_ENABLED=false (never --set-env-vars; the next merge wipes the override - durable off is rolling.enabled: false in config/covered_call.yaml). Pause the schedule instead (survives deploys): gcloud scheduler jobs pause cc-roll-daily --location us-central1. Until FC-114 lands, pause it the day before an NYSE holiday.

NOTES: the filter sets no severity (Cloud Run gives app stderr EMPTY severity; FC-030). A cut cycle does NOT stall the ladder - the orphaned thread keeps running under throttling; the signature is a roll_cycle_started with no roll_cycle_completed (query 1). This policy is the CC roll path's ONLY detective layer (FC-111, FC-107/108). Rate limit 300s so a second same-day roll is seen.

Plan: docs/plans/fc-100.md; docs/plans/fc-078.md

conditions.displayName: CC roll executed, failed, or disposition unknown

conditionMatchedLog.filter: (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_completed" OR textPayload:"call_roll_completed")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_partial_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_naked_exposure" OR textPayload:"call_roll_partial_naked_exposure")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown" OR textPayload:"call_roll_unknown_disposition" OR textPayload:"call_roll_stc_disposition_unknown")) OR (resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name="covered-call-engine" AND (jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_execution_error" OR jsonPayload.error_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR jsonPayload.event_type="call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR jsonPayload.error_type="roll_cycle_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="roll_cycle_error" OR jsonPayload.error_type="roll_position_error" OR jsonPayload.event_type="roll_position_error" OR textPayload:"call_roll_execution_error" OR textPayload:"call_roll_order_refetch_failed" OR textPayload:"roll_cycle_error" OR textPayload:"roll_position_error"))
